items.title: 14.3.2 Human-made sources (insanon ki taraf se) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.3.2, printed page 307.

blocks.text: Human-made sources do type ke hain: mobile (chalne wale: cars, trucks, hawai jahaz, samandari engines) ya point sources (ek jagah lage hue: factories, bijli ghar waghaira). Gariyon ke engines, factories aur power plants mein fossil fuels (coal, fuel oils aur natural gas) ka combustion (jalna) carbon dioxide (CO₂), carbon monoxide (CO) aur hydrocarbons (CH₄) paida karta hai. Ghar mein lakri ko fuel ke taur par jalana aur brick kilns (eenton ke bhatte) mein coal jalana bhi air pollutants ke sources hain.

blocks.caption: Human-made sources
rows: cars, trucks, hawai jahaz, samandari engines

blocks.explanation: Carbon ke oxides (CO, CO₂), nitrogen ke oxides (NOₓ), sulphur ke oxides (SOₓ), hydrocarbons, low altitude ozone (O₃), CFCs, PAHs, POPs, VOCs, particulate matter (PM) aur heavy metals (Pb, Hg, Cd).

blocks.prompt: b) Stratosphere mein ozone ke banne aur depletion (kam hone) ki equations likhein.
blocks.explanation: Oopar wale stratosphere mein ozone UV absorb kar ke toot-ti hai: O₃(g) →(hν) O₂(g) + O(g). Darmiyani stratosphere mein ozone banti hai: O₂(g) + O(g) → O₃(g), jo exothermic reaction hai.

blocks.prompt: c) Atmosphere ki layers ke naam aur un ki taqreeban oonchai likhein.
blocks.explanation: Troposphere 0-12 km, stratosphere 12-50 km, mesosphere 50-85 km aur thermosphere 85-600 km.

items: Human-made sources: mobile (gariyan, jahaz) aur point (factories, power plants); fossil fuels jalne se CO₂, CO aur CH₄; lakri aur bhattiyon ka coal bhi.
